embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: Towards Data-Efficient, Real-Time World Models
fields.value: Microsoft; paper states "This work was carried out at Microsoft." Katja Hofmann is also a known Microsoft Research (Game Intelligence) lead, though per-author affiliation tags were garbled in the HTML. — The authors tackle two barriers to real-time, action-conditioned gameplay world models: slow autoregressive inference and the large data requirements of training.

fields.name: RFW-S: Everyday Deformable Objects with Independent Simulation Verification
fields.value: Alibaba Group; the HTML rendering did not preserve a clean per-author mapping, but Alibaba Group is a stated affiliation for this author group. — RFW-S is a dataset of 83,365 simulation-verified deformable 3D assets across 485 everyday object categories and five structural families (soft solids, cloth sheets, shells, garments, bags), built with an automated reference-guided 3D generation and physics-modeling pipeline.

fields.name: FastFrames: Video Generation at Interactive Latency
fields.value: Apple; Apple is also listed as institution #1 in the paper's affiliation block, and Vladlen Koltun is an Apple researcher. — FastFrames is a family of fast autoregressive video diffusion models built for interactive-latency generation.

fields.name: FailureGen: Scalable Robot Failure Data Generation with World Models
fields.value: NVIDIA — The paper addresses the scarcity of robot-failure data, which the authors say is "difficult to collect at scale," by generating synthetic failure videos with temporal event annotations.

fields.name: FVScore: Specification-Driven Neuro-Symbolic Video Evaluation
fields.value: Google Cloud AI Research — FVScore is a neuro-symbolic framework for evaluating specification-driven video generation.

fields.name: Evolve in Panorama, Render in View: Panoramic World State Evolution for Video World Models
fields.value: Kuaishou Technology; Xin Tao is independently confirmed (public researcher profile) as Senior Researcher/Tech Lead in Kuaishou's Visual Generation ("Kling") Group. Exact per-author mapping was not fully resolvable from the HTML rendering. — PanoEvo is a video world model that keeps the entire scene evolving even when the camera isn't looking at parts of it, using a Panoramic Evolver that updates scene state in the latent space of a panoramic video diffusion model so every viewing direction changes consistently over time.

fields.name: Decoding Without a Decoder: Direct Pixel Prediction from Diffusion Transformers
fields.value: other authors are listed with Stanford University / Caltech) (flag) — Latent diffusion models normally need a separate decoder to turn denoised latents into pixels, adding complexity and inference cost.

fields.name: DOOM-GS: Dynamic Out-of-core Optimization for Massive Gaussian Splatting
fields.value: Baidu Research — DOOM-GS is presented as the first out-of-core optimization method designed specifically for massive-scale dynamic Gaussian Splatting, where spatio-temporal primitives exceed available GPU memory.

fields.name: WinDEX: Metric 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild for Dexterous Teleoperation and Policy Learning
fields.value: other co-authors are at City University of Hong Kong (flag) — Collecting large-scale, metrically accurate 3D hand-motion data in the wild is hard, limiting data for training dexterous robot hands.

fields.name: UNITE: Consolidating Embodied VLM Specialists via Shared-Anchor One-Bit Factorization
fields.value: ACE Robotics, Shanghai; standing unclear, kept per borderline rule). Other authors: Sichuan University, Nanyang Technological University, Sun Yat-sen University (Shenzhen). — UNITE consolidates multiple fine-tuned vision-language-model (VLM) "specialists" — for visual grounding, spatial reasoning, navigation, and driving understanding — into a single compact mixture-of-experts model instead of deploying them separately or merging them into one conflict-prone dense model.

fields.name: Reference Forcing: Long Video Generation with Region-Guided Drift Correction
fields.value: Adobe — Long autoregressive video generators drift in subject/background appearance over time because they are distilled over short windows and KV-cache history can itself have drifted.

fields.name: MovieRoll: A Systematic Framework for Rolling Out Long-Form Videos
fields.value: Tencent Hunyuan (one of three affiliations listed on the paper, alongside Peking University and HKUST; exact per-author mapping was not extractable from the HTML, but a footnote notes some authors' work was "done during an internship at Tencent Hunyuan," indicating Tencent Hunyuan staff co-authorship) — Streaming video generators must sustain quality beyond their training horizon while managing growing self-generated history and KV-cache costs.

fields.name: FaceRiff: Data-Efficient Unified Text-to-3D Face Asset Synthesis via Geometric Conditioning
fields.value: Electronic Arts — FaceRiff generates complete 3D face assets — mesh, albedo, and displacement — from text prompts in a shared UV space.

fields.name: DuoFlow: Towards Synchronized Speech and Motion Generation with Fine-Grained Control
fields.value: Tencent — Existing joint speech-motion generation models only implicitly condition on transcript semantics or speech features, giving little explicit control over motion hierarchy, body parts, or vocal style.

fields.name: DreamFAR: Real-Time and Long-Horizon Interaction with Diverse Objects
fields.value: Amazon; per-author mapping was not separable in the HTML. — Existing robot-manipulation world models either overfit to a single environment or fail to simulate long-horizon, contact-rich interactions.
